notes:
Summary:
- Velarum Aerospace Systems evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for inference workloads that must meet ITAR/data residency constraints. Primary use: streaming telemetry embeddings + real-time ops chat for mission control, plus document search/reranking across maintenance manuals.

Qualification highlights (from calls):
- Security/Compliance: must be ITAR-compatible, SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred. Primary legal ask: ensure no egress of raw telemetry outside U.S. region.
- KMS/BYOK: customer wants customer-managed keys (AWS KMS + HSM option). Integration needs to support envelope encryption and HSM-backed attestation.
- Audit Logging: central logging into their Splunk instance; logs must include token-level request identifiers, model version, route, and correlation id. Retention policy: 7 years for specific telemetry events.
- Network/topology: VPC-only deployment, no internet egress for model telemetry. Transit Gateway or VPC Peering acceptable. Private ECR/S3 endpoints required.
- Regions: US-East-1 primary; evaluate GovCloud for classified pipelines (legal to confirm).

Recent activities / timeline:
- 2026-01-15: initial inbound lead from partner - AE introduced (Jordan Patel) and SE follow-up requested. (created record)
- 2026-01-20: discovery call (ff-20260120-7890). Attendees: Jordan P., Aisha R., Velarum SecOps (M. Russo), Platform Eng (S. Lee). Captured high-level needs + ITAR mention.
- 2026-01-28: technical deep-dive (ff-20260128-8123). Walked through candidate VPC topologies, BYOK options, and audit log flows. Aisha to draft POC topology.
- 2026-02-02: procurement planning call; buyer requested priced POC options and SLA outline. Confirmed procurement window Q2->Q3.

Architecture fit notes (SE sketch / questions):
- Suggested topology A (preferred for POC): single-account Redwood Private control plane in customer-managed VPC with dedicated inference subnets. Use private subnets for inference nodes, NAT for outbound only to approved registries (private ECR), deny general internet egress.
- Transit/Peering: prefer Transit Gateway for multi-VPC customers (Velarum has 4 VPCs for telemetry, ops, analytics, staging). Need TGW attachment and route propagation plan.
- Inbound: no inbound public load balancers. All API calls originate from Velarum app VPCs to Redwood private endpoints via VPC peering/TGW. Use PrivateLink or interface endpoints for additional isolation if needed.
- Outbound: restrict to specific AWS services (S3, ECR) via VPC endpoints. No outbound to public model registries. Model updates must be pushed via secure CI/CD pipeline over private endpoints.
- KMS: BYOK flow sketched: Velarum creates CMK in their account; Redwood service needs decrypt capability via cross-account key policy + IAM role. For HSM-level assurance, recommend integration with customer HSM provider (Thales/CloudHSM).
- Audit streaming: Redwood to push structured audit logs to Velarum Splunk via Kinesis Firehose or direct S3 ingestion with signed transfer; logs MUST include: timestamp, request_id, model_hash, model_version, route, token_count, response_latency, user_id.
- Data residency: ensure storage buckets and logs are in US East region; POC must avoid replication to other regions.

Quoted from Velarum SecOps: "We cannot have any telemetry or model prompts leaving the US account or accessible to third parties — ITAR is non-negotiable. Need attestation for key handling."

POC proposal (notes for next meeting):
- 6-week POC: private single-AZ deployment with dedicated GPU nodes (small cluster), model pinned to curated open checkpoint, BYOK KMS test, audit log pipeline to Velarum Splunk, simulated traffic for 200 RPS (telemetry ingest) and 50 concurrent chat sessions.
- Deliverables: architecture diagram, runbook for VPC/TGW configuration, KMS policy snippets, audit mapping, cost estimate for Dedicated GPUs + Private control plane.

Open questions for Velarum legal/security:
- Confirm whether GovCloud is required for any subset of workloads.
- Confirm acceptable audit log retention and legal hold procedures.
- Define SLA/penalty language for PII/telemetry leakage (legal wants wording).

- SE: prepare BYOK integration example + IAM policy snippet (Aisha) — schedule code review with Velarum infra.
- Security: schedule 60m deep-dive with Velarum SecOps and Redwood security (Tom + Aisha) week of 2026-02-08.
